_about.what: Years added after the Benefacts archive ends, from sources outside it.
_about.sign: Expenditure is stored negative, matching the Benefacts convention.
_about.caution: These figures come from the Charities Regulator's annual return, not from a full set of filed accounts. They are headline figures on the Regulator's own definitions and are not line-for-line comparable with the 182 fields Benefacts extracted. Where the two sources overlap they are not merged: the archive is left as it stands.

cra-ar.name: Charities Regulator — annual reports
cra-ar.licence: Open data, re-use of public sector information
cra-ar.notes: Bulk file. 83,051 annual report records. Employee and volunteer counts before 2021 are published as bands ('250-499') and are not used. From 2021 the Regulator collects full-time and part-time counts as integers; the employee figure here is their sum, a headcount, which is not the same measure as the average-employees figure in the Benefacts archive. Government funding is the sum of 'Income: Government or Local Authorities' and 'Income: Other Public Bodies', because charities reclassify between the two.
